name: Guodian Nanjing Automation Co., Ltd.
summary: Guodian Nanjing Automation Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of industrial power automation equipment in China and internationally. It offers safety and stability control and power plant electrical, as well as high, medium, and low voltage relay protection products; and automation and communication products, such as substation and distribution network automation, system auxiliary equipment, and power supply.
